name: Genki humanoid (unnamed prototype)
summary: The first robot from Genki Robotics, the Tokyo startup Android creator Andy Rubin co-founded in May 2025. It was shown publicly for the first time on 12 November 2026 at Prime Minister Takaichi's physical-AI meeting, three days after its first steps. Genki designs its own actuators and cameras around Japanese suppliers and plans an open, Android-style software platform for outside developers.
notable: Built by the creator of Android, pitched as an open developer platform

sources.title: Andy Rubin's Genki Robotics Shows Its Humanoid to Japan's Prime Minister — Humanoids Daily
